name: fxf_scene13_stairs
doc: Stands in for the state saves/scene13_stairs.wram was made from: the ROM's own loader (--teleport 13 13 29 3, method jmp, 200 frames) from the bed slide places the lead in loc 00D at tile (13,29), one tile left of the slope's foot -- the reference's own provenance, from the recipe-made bed slide.
